description: The shared in-use rule for project assets: the app's Delete unused sheet and pack review (src-tauri/src/media.rs AssetRefs) and kb's unused listing read these cases. Each case lays out a workspace: files (empty, under the project), project.json, scene sidecars and modules (keys may name a nested folder under scenes/), edit documents, and workspace themes (themes/<slug>/theme.json beside the project).
rule: The corpus is project.json, every scenes/**/*.json and *.tsx (dot names skipped), edits/*.json, and themes/<slug>/theme.json for every ws:<slug> named by a themeId anywhere in project.json or a sidecar (project theme, scene themes, compare.b).
A file is referenced when its rel (assets/...) appears as a substring of any corpus file, or matches a pattern.

Patterns come from string literals that open on assets/ or ./assets/ right after a quote (", ' or `): a template substitution ${...} in a backtick literal becomes *, a literal followed by + becomes <literal>*, and a literal ending in / becomes <literal>*. Only literals with a * are patterns; a literal that breaks a line or never closes makes none. * matches any run of characters, / included.
assets/_meta.json is always referenced. assets/<stem>.timing.json is referenced exactly when a file assets/<stem>.<ext> (one extension) is.
unused is every file not referenced, minus the sample pool: names that sit flat under assets/ and appear in samplePool. The app further limits its sheet to media extensions.

cases.name: json strings, tsx literals, the manifest and edit documents
a template literal becomes a glob
a concatenation becomes a glob up to the operator
a folder literal covers everything under it

tsx.04-shots.tsx:
const dir = "assets/shots/";
const src = dir + name;

cases.name: a leading ./ and a nested scenes folder
the workspace themes the project and its scenes use
the restored sample pool is never unused
a timing record follows its mezzanine and the provenance record is kept
near misses and prose are not references

tsx.01-intro.tsx:
// put screens in assets/ first
export const note = "see assets/logo for more";

cases.name: a bare assets/ literal keeps every file
